$comment: GP-ID-R1 provenance map: every IntentContractV1 / MilestoneV1 field traced to its frozen source, or explicitly listed as UNRESOLVED. materialization_timing = POST_GP2_REMEDIATION is disclosed everywhere; nothing pretends these objects existed before GP2 execution.

intent_id.source: UNRESOLVED — deterministic UUID derived from task_freeze_hash (convention: deriveUuid('gp001:intent:' + task_freeze_hash)). Commander must freeze this derivation or assign a specific UUID.

version.source: GP-001 is a single-version intent (no amendment history exists in the frozen task record). Version 1 requires no parent_hash.

owner_subject.source: UNRESOLVED — the frozen task record names no bounty sponsor. GP0 contract §11 says the Commander owns scope; this must be Commander-frozen.

statement.value: Fix the GP-001 seeded retryFetch bug: on HTTP 429, honor Retry-After seconds as an exact millisecond delay before retrying.
statement.source: Frozen GP-001 task spec (docs/GOLDEN-PATH-V1.md §1 + gp-001-task.json acceptance criteria 1-4, transcribed verbatim).

target_state.value: The frozen acceptance suite passes on the patched code with build/typecheck green.

domain.source: UNRESOLVED — domain label not present in any frozen source. Commander must freeze.

success_criteria.source: Derived from gp-001-task.json acceptance criteria 1-8 + acceptance_suite_sha256. Each criterion maps to one frozen acceptance-suite test block (A1-A4) or a runner-enforced rule (A5: allowed-paths, A6: build). Criterion semantics follow the G1 CriterionV1 wire exactly.

constraints.source: Derived from gp-001-task.json forbidden_paths + max_attempts + deadline. Each constraint maps to a frozen fact.

asset.source: gp-001-task.json asset triple (solana-devnet / USDC-test / 6, exact copy).

execution_cap.source: UNRESOLVED — no frozen source distinguishes execution_cap from total. Set equal to total (zero execution overhead); Commander must confirm or adjust.

deadline.source: gp-001-task.json deadline 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z, converted to TimestampSchema format 2026-10-31T23:59:59.000Z.

verification_policy_ref.source: UNRESOLVED — HashRefSchema requires {uri, hash}. The GP2 bundle policy_hash (sha256:b8933eb4...) is derivable, but the URI (where the 2-of-2 policy document lives) has no frozen source. Commander must provide the policy document URI.

settlement_policy_ref.source: UNRESOLVED — HashRefSchema requires {uri, hash}. No settlement policy document exists yet (GP4 = HOLD). Commander must provide or defer.

parent_hash.source: absent — version 1 requires no parent_hash (G1 schema rule).

created_at.source: UNRESOLVED — no frozen timestamp for intent creation. The GP-001 task freeze was committed at af08fdfa (2026-09-21). The honest value is the task-freeze commit's author date, but it must be Commander-frozen, not silently assigned.

milestone_id.source: PASSED GP2 bundle.milestone_id (frozen anchor at 3fbef70, object-database bytes). Milestone MUST use the same UUID.

intent_hash.source: MUST equal the sealed IntentContractV1.content_hash (check #5). Not derivable until the Intent is sealed.

criterion_ids.source: MUST match the Intent's success_criteria criterion_ids (same UUIDs, same canonical order).

verification_policy_hash.source: MUST equal PASSED GP2 bundle.policy_hash sha256:b8933eb4... (check #8).

settlement_policy_hash.source: UNRESOLVED — no settlement policy exists (GP4 = HOLD). If the Intent's settlement_policy_ref.hash is Commander-frozen, the Milestone must reference the same value. If deferred, this field blocks materialization.

UNRESOLVED_FIELDS: intent.budget.execution_cap — no frozen split from total
intent.settlement_policy_ref.{uri,hash} — no settlement policy exists (GP4 HOLD)
intent.intent_id — derivation convention proposed but needs Commander freeze
frozen_sources_used: packages/golden-path/evidence/9f6610dc-24e9-4e6c-b7c1-67574064d2ae/bundle.json (PASSED GP2 anchor at main@3fbef70, object-database bytes)
